## Contract and outcomes

attachSync takes host-owned transport, exact peer identity, current authorization and SyncSession options. Await its attachment; the host drives receive/pump for frames and retry deadlines and detaches when finished. Collaboration is explicitly enabled per editor and reuses the local replica/history.

## Errors and recovery

Deny or revoke attachment when identity, schema, epoch or current authority mismatches. Detach and cancel stale callbacks; preserve local unsent edits. Retrying a transport is not authorization to replace document state.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

PIN-1.3 uses a prepared local bridge and actual sync owner. Sending Yjs frames or convergence is not a durable remote-save receipt. No configured cloud host, anonymous proxy, or actual network/provider qualification is supplied.
